title: Shaded Regions Practice Exam
description: Practice finding area left after removing circular parts. Show the subtraction idea in each explanation.

questions.question: A 12 cm by 8 cm rectangle has a circle with radius 2 cm removed. Which setup finds the shaded area?
questions.explanation: The rectangle is the whole area and the circle is removed, so the setup is $12 \times 8 - 3.14(2^2)$.

questions.question: A 10 m by 6 m rectangle has a circular hole with radius 2 m. Using $\pi = 3.14$, what is the area left? Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: Whole area: $10 \times 6 = 60$. Removed area: $3.14(2^2) = 12.56$. Subtract: $60 - 12.56 = 47.44$ square meters.

questions.question: If a circular part is removed from a rectangle, the shaded area is found by subtracting the circle area from the rectangle area.
questions.explanation: Removed parts are cut out, so the shaded area is the whole rectangle area minus the removed circle area.

questions.question: A circle has diameter 8 cm. What radius should be used in $A = \pi r^2$?
questions.explanation: The radius is half the diameter: $8 \div 2 = 4$ cm.

questions.question: A square has side length 9 cm. A circle with radius 3 cm is removed. Using $\pi = 3.14$, what is the shaded area? Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: Whole area: $9^2 = 81$. Removed area: $3.14(3^2) = 28.26$. Subtract: $81 - 28.26 = 52.74$ square centimeters.

questions.question: A square has four equal quarter circles removed from its corners. Together, the four removed parts make:
questions.explanation: Four equal quarter circles combine to make one whole circle.

questions.question: A 14 cm by 10 cm rectangle has a semicircle with radius 3 cm removed. Use $\pi = 3.14$. Show the subtraction step and give the area left.
questions.correctAnswer: Whole area is 14 x 10 = 140. Removed semicircle area is 1/2(3.14)(3^2) = 14.13. Subtract: 140 - 14.13 = 125.87 square centimeters.
questions.explanation: The whole rectangle is $140$. The removed semicircle is $\frac{1}{2}(3.14)(9)=14.13$. The area left is $140 - 14.13 = 125.87$ square centimeters.

questions.question: Explain why an answer for a shaded area left after removing a circular hole should be less than the area of the whole shape.
questions.correctAnswer: Because a circular part was removed, the shaded area is the whole area minus a positive area, so it must be smaller than the whole.
questions.explanation: When area is removed, you subtract a positive amount from the whole. That makes the remaining area smaller than the whole area.
